sanitization: All fixtures and operator values are synthetic and marked SYNTHETIC_P00_ONLY.

cases.title: Paid plan history mutation
preconditions: Load the paid generated fixture.
The paid item has templateProtected=false and its source template has edited fields.
steps: The characterization applies the current mutability predicate to the paid generated record.
cases.expected_current_result: The paid record remains eligible for rebuild because eligibility ignores isPaid.
cases.captured_current_result: Paid=true and templateProtected=false evaluates as mutable under the production predicate.
cases.p01_action: Fix or visibly block paid generated mutation.

cases.title: Partial plan application
preconditions: Load the plan-edit fixture in an isolated browser profile.
Inject a deterministic failure on the second IndexedDB delete/put request.
steps: Inspect the database after the injected failure.
Compare completed deletes/updates with pending creates.
cases.expected_current_result: Earlier writes persist although the overall apply fails.
cases.captured_current_result: Source inspection confirms separate awaited delete/update/create transactions with no encompassing transaction.
cases.manual_justification: The production prototype exposes no supported fault-injection seam; reproducing the interrupted-write boundary requires an operator-controlled IndexedDB failure wrapper and is retained as a structured manual gate.
cases.p01_action: Make plan apply atomic or visibly block it.

cases.title: Partial import
preconditions: Use the weak-schema-accepted fake backup.
Inject failure after one successful import write.
steps: Choose the fake backup and confirm import.
Trigger the deterministic later write failure.
cases.expected_current_result: Earlier imported records persist after the later failure.
cases.captured_current_result: Source inspection confirms settings, templates, and expenses are saved sequentially without rollback.
cases.manual_justification: A faithful partial-write reproduction needs deterministic FileReader/UI confirmation and IndexedDB failure injection unavailable through the ordinary product interface.
cases.p01_action: Make import atomic or visibly block it.

cases.title: Duplicate non-atomic settlement
preconditions: Use a fake positive prior-cycle surplus.
Fail the settlement-setting write after the vault transaction succeeds.
steps: Retain the first vault transfer after the injected failure.
Retry settlement and inspect vault transactions.
cases.expected_current_result: Retry can create a second transfer for one settlement.
cases.captured_current_result: Source inspection confirms addVaultTransaction completes before upsertMonthEndSettlement and uses a new UUID on retry.
cases.manual_justification: The defect occurs only at an exact asynchronous storage failure boundary; controlled fault injection is required to avoid manufacturing a production write failure in source.
cases.p01_action: Make settlement atomic and idempotent.

cases.title: False cycle surplus
preconditions: Budget is 1000 SAR, paid actuals are 100 SAR, and an unpaid essential reservation is 500 SAR.
steps: Evaluate the production snapshot rule that totals only paid expenses.
cases.expected_current_result: Snapshot surplus is 900 instead of the reservation-aware 400.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated characterization records current=900 and reservation-aware=400.
cases.p01_action: Include unpaid reserved obligations in availability and settlement.

cases.title: Goal double counting
preconditions: Vault balance is 100 SAR and two goals each target 100 SAR.
steps: Apply the current per-goal progress mapping.
cases.expected_current_result: Both goals report 100% from the same 100 SAR.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated characterization records progress [100,100] against one balance of 100.
cases.p01_action: Use goal-owned allocations only.

cases.title: Legacy vault disappearance
preconditions: Legacy vault balance is 650 SAR and transaction history sums to 100 SAR.
steps: Apply the current vault normalization branch.
cases.expected_current_result: Normalized balance becomes 100 and 550 disappears.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated characterization records fallback=650, transaction-derived=100, current=100.
cases.p01_action: Preserve the standalone legacy opening value.

cases.title: Dangerous reset blockage
preconditions: Open two same-origin tabs with the populated fake fixture.
Keep the first tab database connection open.
steps: Request factory reset from the second tab.
Observe blocked deletion and reload behavior.
cases.expected_current_result: Database deletion can remain blocked and non-cleared preferences survive.
cases.captured_current_result: Source inspection confirms no onblocked handler and reset clears theme/motion but not language/calendar.
cases.manual_justification: The condition requires real multi-tab IndexedDB connection ownership and timing; a structured two-tab operator run is the faithful reproduction.
cases.p01_action: Add a safe visible reset-blocked path and complete preference cleanup.

cases.title: UTC local-date error
preconditions: Instant is 2026-01-01T21:30:00.000Z in Asia/Riyadh, whose civil date is 2026-01-02.
steps: Compare toISOString date with Riyadh civil date.
cases.expected_current_result: Current helper returns 2026-01-01 instead of 2026-01-02.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated characterization records UTC=2026-01-01 and Riyadh=2026-01-02.
cases.p01_action: Use local civil date semantics.

cases.title: Floating-point money
preconditions: Two paid actual amounts are 0.1 and 0.2 major units.
steps: Sum the values using the current Number arithmetic.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated characterization records the IEEE-754 residue.
cases.p01_action: Contain unsafe numeric inputs pending integer-money domain work.

cases.title: Historical budget rewrite
preconditions: A prior-cycle expense exists and baseAllowance changes from 2400 to 3000.
steps: Evaluate getBudgetForMonth before and after changing the one mutable allowance.
cases.expected_current_result: The prior month budget changes to the new allowance.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated characterization confirms every month reads the same current baseAllowance.
cases.p01_action: Contain misleading history and assign final ownership to the versioned cycle domain.

cases.title: Home date and month mismatch
preconditions: Select a date outside the real current month.
steps: Compare selected-date context with safeToSpend calculation source.
cases.expected_current_result: The heading follows the selected date while the amount uses the real current month.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated source characterization confirms safeToSpend calls getTodayISO independently of currentDate.
cases.p01_action: Keep displayed context and calculation period aligned.

cases.title: False weekly pace
preconditions: Monthly remaining is 900 SAR and weekly mode is selected.
cases.expected_current_result: Weekly display is always 225 SAR regardless of remaining days.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated characterization records 900/4=225.
cases.p01_action: Label or contain the false pace pending deterministic pacing.

cases.title: Missing monthly schedule day
preconditions: A monthly template is created through the normal template form with no days array.
steps: Evaluate monthly occurrence days for an empty days array.
cases.expected_current_result: The template has no occurrence on any date.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated characterization records zero normalized days and zero occurrences.
cases.p01_action: Require a schedule day or visibly block monthly creation.

cases.title: Ignored assignment effective date and profile revision
preconditions: The month assignment starts mid-month and the assigned profile/template is edited later.
steps: Inspect the current resolution of assignment and mutable template record.
cases.expected_current_result: The month-wide lookup uses the current profile/template without an immutable revision boundary.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated characterization confirms assignment lookup is by monthKey and template lookup uses current records.
cases.p01_action: Contain unsafe profile reapplication pending versioned plan domain work.

cases.title: Stale derived state
preconditions: Delay the first getAllExpenses result in a large fake ledger.
Select a second date before releasing the first request.
steps: Start and finish loadDay for date B.
Release A and inspect flexible/statistics month keys.
cases.expected_current_result: A late first request can start the last derived refresh and publish for the now-stale date.
cases.captured_current_result: Source inspection confirms loadDay guards currentViewExpenses but still calls derived refreshes after a stale expense fetch.
cases.manual_justification: The race requires deterministic IndexedDB scheduling across overlapping requests; source must remain untouched in P00, so a controlled browser delay is the faithful reproduction.
cases.p01_action: Guard the entire load/derived pipeline by one generation.

cases.title: Weak numeric validation
preconditions: Use negative, excess-precision, non-finite, Arabic, and Western numeric strings.
cases.expected_current_result: Invalid financial values are not rejected by one checked boundary.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated characterization records accepted negative/excess-precision values and inconsistent Arabic parsing.
cases.p01_action: Visibly block unsafe numeric values pending canonical money normalization.

cases.title: Weak import schema
preconditions: Use a backup containing expenses=[] plus malformed settings/templates.
steps: Apply the production import gate predicate.
cases.expected_current_result: The malformed backup passes the only meaningful top-level check.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated characterization records weak-schema-accepted=true.
cases.p01_action: Validate the complete backup schema or visibly block import.

cases.title: Hard-coded and nonfunctional analytics
preconditions: Compare two materially different fake histories.
steps: Inspect the current profile trend seed and activity-dot predicate.
cases.expected_current_result: Trend input remains hard-coded and activity dots remain disabled.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated source characterization finds the mock trend array and always-false activity indicator.
cases.p01_action: Contain misleading analytics and assign final ownership to later Insights work.

cases.title: Current gamification misincentive
preconditions: Record 100 SAR positive variance from spending less than expected.
cases.expected_current_result: The user receives 1000 XP based on underspending amount.
cases.captured_current_result: Automated characterization records 100*10=1000 XP and wealth-flavored badge thresholds.
cases.p01_action: Visibly disable or replace the harmful reward basis.
